COREHAUL · MELTDOWN MILE · VERTICAL SLICE
COREHAUL
The Cinder Rig's reactor clamp has failed. It is rolling itself down Meltdown Mile to the containment cradle — and it cannot stop or steer. You are the Haulbreaker crew: ram, crush and blast a path through anything in the marked lane, bridge the collapsed culvert with the MULE, and get that rig home before its hull gives out.
W/Sthrottle / brake
A/Dsteer
Spacehandbrake
Eswap to nearby unit
Fdump rubble (MULE)
Rrecover unit
Ccamera far/near
Ppause · M mute
Three units: HORNBACK wedge dozer (ram), MULE tipper (hauls rubble), DART scout (fast). Blue surge cells explode — handy, but they can wound the rig too.
START ENGINE
ready — click START ENGINE (or press Enter).
